parameters.query:
=WITH dup_check AS (
  SELECT id, title, similarity(title, '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}') AS sim
  FROM public.crawled_articles
  WHERE crawled_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days'
    AND (url = '{{ $json.url }}' OR similarity(title, '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}') > 0.65)
  ORDER BY sim DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO public.crawled_articles (
  title,
  url,
  summary,
  content_raw,
  key_points,
  source_name,
  source_category,
  source_url,
  sentiment,
  tags,
  title_hash,
  is_duplicate,
  duplicate_of_id,
  published_date,
  crawled_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.url }}',
  '{{ $json.summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.content_raw || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.key_points || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.source_name }}',
  '{{ $json.source_category }}',
  '{{ $json.source_url }}',
  '{{ $json.sentiment }}',
  ARRAY[{{ ($json.tags || []).map(t => "'" + t.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  '{{ $json.title_hash }}',
  CASE WHEN (SELECT id FROM dup_check) IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END,
  (SELECT id FROM dup_check),
  {{ $json.published_date ? "'" + $json.published_date + "'::timestamptz" : "NULL" }},
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (url) DO UPDATE 
SET 
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
  content_raw = EXCLUDED.content_raw
RETURNING id, title, is_duplicate, duplicate_of_id;
=UPDATE public.crawl_targets SET last_crawled_at = NOW(), last_status = 'success' WHERE id = {{ $('4. Lọc URL Bài Viết (Code)').first().json.source_id }};

=INSERT INTO public.crawl_targets (source_name, source_category, source_url, active, last_status)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.body?.source_name || $json.source_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.body?.source_category || $json.source_category || 'Tài chính').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.body?.source_url || $json.source_url || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  true,
  'pending'
)
ON CONFLICT (source_url) DO UPDATE
SET source_name = EXCLUDED.source_name,
    source_category = EXCLUDED.source_category,
    active = true,
    last_status = 'pending'
RETURNING id, source_name, source_category, source_url, active, last_status;
